name: snapshots
title: Snapshots
description: Which dates gold has data for, per source, oldest first. Use it to confirm a date exists before concluding a balance is zero. Example: {source: "schwab"}.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

latest_only.description: Only the newest date per source.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: One source id, or a comma list. Default: every source.
